query: For a 69‑year‑old man with TIA, among male TIA patients aged 64–74 (LOS 1–7 days), what's the mean ultrasounds/echocardiograms per admission: 1–3 vs 4–7 days, stratified by ICU use?
final_sql:
SELECT
  has_icu_stay,
  CASE
    WHEN los_days BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3 days'
    WHEN los_days BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '4-7 days'
  END AS los_group,
  AVG(num_ultrasounds) AS mean_ultrasounds_per_admission;
